name: Childcare / daycare center
summary: Licensed childcare centers are one-story, residential-scale (often wood-frame) buildings of 6k-15k SF with many small classrooms, high plumbing density (child-height toilets and sinks in or next to each room), a kitchen, and a fenced outdoor play yard of ~75 SF per child. Public cost data is thin: values come from the RSMeans 2019 day-care model and a 2019 Purdue University child care budget, so the hard cost is a DERIVED estimate in 2019 dollars (the build script escalates) - verify against a franchise FDD Item 7 or local bids.

typicalSize.method: RSMeans model is 10,000 SF (e1); Purdue facilities 16,400-16,600 GSF for 140-150 children (e2, e4). Franchise/independent centers commonly 8k-12k SF for ~120-180 children. Licensed capacity ~ SF / 100-115 GSF per child (e2: ~111 GSF/child).

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Building SF per site acre. A 10,000 SF center for ~100-150 children needs ~7,500-11,250 SF of outdoor play (75 SF/child, e5) plus drop-off loop and parking; 1.0-1.5 acre sites are typical (~7,000-10,000 SF/acre). Derived.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Spaces per building SF (= 2.5-5 per 1,000 SF): one per staff member plus short-term drop-off spaces. Derived; local code governs.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Derived, expressed in 2019 dollars (all anchors are 2019) for the build script to escalate. Building-only anchors: RSMeans 2019 day care hard cost w/o A/E = $140.46 x 1.25 = ~$176/SF (e1, national); Purdue 2019 construction lines $201/GSF (e2, IN, institutional quality). Add on-site work (playground surfacing/fencing, drop-off loop, parking, utilities) at ~15%-25% of building cost -> ~$205-$250/SF. Mid $245 = Purdue building + ~20% site; low $175 = RSMeans building-only economy wood-frame with minimal site; high $340 ~ Purdue 2015 all-in project rate ($323/GSF, e4) used as the ceiling for high-quality institutional centers. Expect ~+40%-50% escalation to 2025-26.

scope.notes: Contractor price incl. GC/OH&P, play-yard fencing/surfacing, drop-off/parking, on-site utilities and landscaping; excludes land, soft costs, playground equipment (line item), loose FF&E, off-sites and fees.

qualityTiers.method: Low/mid and high/mid of the derived range ($175/$245 = 0.71; $340/$245 = 1.39), rounded; institutional/university centers (e2, e4) sit at premium.

systemSplit.method: Derived. Purdue's construction lines split structure 78% / mechanical 16% / electrical 6% of building cost (e2: $2.6M / $524k / $205k), i.e. MEP ~22% of building; this split keeps HVAC+plumbing+FP at ~20% and electrical/low-voltage ~12% of total, with plumbing raised (9%) for child-height fixtures in each classroom. Wood frame (06 8%) per the RSMeans model (e1); site 12% (31-33) reflects fenced play yards and drop-off loop.

lineItems.name: Playground equipment, shade and safety surfacing (per play yard)

cost.method: Derived allowance per age-group play yard (infant/toddler and preschool yards are usually separated); outdoor area sized at 75 SF per child (e5).

lineItems.notes: Not in baseline hard cost; add per play yard.

lineItems.name: Kitchen (residential-grade warming to commercial with hood)

cost.method: Derived allowance; centers that cook on site need a Type I hood and grease interceptor.

lineItems.name: Child-height toilets/sinks and classroom diaper/hand-wash stations

cost.method: Derived: per fixture installed incl. rough-in; ~1 fixture per 500 SF (2 per 1,000 SF) reflects licensing ratios of ~1 toilet and sink per 10-15 children.

lineItems.name: Secured entry, access control and classroom cameras

cost.method: Derived allowance; parent-viewable camera systems are common in franchise centers.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Purdue budget carries movable equipment $215,000 + fixed equipment $75,000 on 16,600 GSF (~$17.5/GSF, e3); range widened for franchise classroom packages.

pctOfHard.method: Purdue architectural fee $280,500 = ~8.4% of the $3.33M construction lines (e3); add permits/licensing plan review, survey/geotech, testing, legal and owner PM for ~12%-20% in private development; institutional owners with 'other' costs run higher. Excludes FF&E and contingency.

softCosts.notes: State childcare licensing plan review and health-department (kitchen) review add schedule but small fees.

design.method: Derived: simple one-story building with a repeatable program.

perPrimaryUnit.method: 2019 dollars: low ~ $175 hard x 1.12; high ~ Purdue all-in $416/GSF (2019, incl. site and land, e3) rounded up.

source.title: RSMeans square foot cost model: Day Care Center (Brick Veneer / Wood Frame), 1 story

evidence.quote: Model page cost table (10,000 SF, 2019 data): SubTotal $140.46/SF; Contractor Fees 25%; Architectural Fees 9%; Total Building Cost $191.38/SF (union)
evidence.scopeNotes: Building only, union labor, 2019 national average; includes contractor GC/OH&P (25%) AND architect fees; excludes sitework, land, FF&E. Hard cost w/o A/E fee = SubTotal x 1.25. Stale (2019) and well below current bids; used for relative ratios between types only.

source.title: Daycare Construction Cost Per Square Foot: Sourced Data
source.publisher: Buildermuse (citing Indiana State Budget Agency project B-1-20-1-11, Jan 15 2020)

evidence.quote: about 16,600 gross square feet, serving about 150 children ... the three construction lines total $3,329,000, about $201 per gross square foot
evidence.scopeNotes: Purdue University child care facility approved Dec 2019. Construction lines = structure $2.6M + mechanical $524k + electrical $205k (building only); site development is combined with land acquisition in a separate $1,757,000 line, so sitework is excluded here.

source.title: Daycare Construction Cost Per Square Foot: Sourced Data
source.publisher: Buildermuse (citing Indiana State Budget Agency project B-1-20-1-11, Jan 15 2020)

evidence.quote: Total estimated project cost: $6,900,000, funded from university operating reserves.
evidence.scopeNotes: All-in incl. architectural $280,500, movable equipment $215,000, fixed equipment $75,000, site development/land $1,757,000, other $1,243,500. = ~$416/GSF and ~$46,000 per child (150 children).

source.title: Daycare Construction Cost Per Square Foot: Sourced Data

evidence.quote: Purdue's Early Care and Education Center, completed in 2015, at 16,400 gross square feet, $5.3 million, ... $323 per gross square foot and capacity for 140 children.
evidence.scopeNotes: Total project cost per GSF (scope of 'cost' not itemized); 117 GSF per child.

source.title: Daycare Construction Cost Per Square Foot: Sourced Data

evidence.quote: require at least 35 square feet of usable indoor space per child ... at least 75 square feet of usable outdoor play space per child
evidence.scopeNotes: Regulatory minimums; usable activity space excludes halls, toilets, kitchens and storage, so gross building SF per child is ~2.5-3.5x the 35 SF minimum.

openQuestions: No current (2024-26) sourced childcare hard cost was found: franchise FDD Item 7 build-out ranges (Primrose, Goddard, Kiddie Academy, Lightbridge) and state childcare facility grant program data should be pulled to replace this derived estimate.
Per-child metrics (cost per licensed child, SF per child) depend on state licensing ratios; ~100-115 GSF per child is used from the Purdue example only.
Purdue figures are cited via a secondary article quoting the Indiana State Budget Agency request; verify against the original.
